title: cordia polystachya
intro: Cordia polystachya, commonly known as Wild Plum or Caranda, is a plant species in the Bignoniaceae family native to tropical and subtropical regions of the Americas. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine due to its multiple health benefits, which include treating digestive issues, such as diarrhea and dysentery, and its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Cordia polystachya include its antimicrobial, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory effects, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Cordia polystachya include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
